📊 Dashboard

import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { UserHttpService } from 'src/app/user-http.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-dashboard', templateUrl: './dashboard.component.html', styleUrls: ['./dashboard.component.css'] }) export class DashboardComponent { adminRole : boolean = false; airlineRole : boolean = false; passengerRole : boolean = false; constructor(private login: UserHttpService){} ngOnInit() : void{ this.adminRole = this.login.is_admin(); this.airlineRole = this.login.is_airline(); this.passengerRole = this.login.is_passenger(); } }
